subject: Acme - Pricing & Invoice Estimate
summary: Post-discovery follow-up capturing token volume assumptions, target $/1M token budget, and attached invoice estimate & cost model. Awaiting PO and formal quote sign-off.
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - Pricing & next steps (recap)

Alicia - thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Goal: integrate Redwood inference into Acme's support assistant (responses + reranking + occasional embeddings for search).
- Primary workloads: generation for chat (multiturn) and embeddings for similarity/rerank.
- Usage signals you gave on the call: ~10k DAU for the initial pilot, estimated average session ~120 tokens generated, ~3 embeddings per session.
- Expected pilot horizon: 3 months, with production ramp to ~100k DAU over 12 months if metrics hold.

Ask from our side to build the cost model & invoice: could you confirm an expected monthly token volume range (low / mid / high) for the pilot and target $/1M tokens that your finance team is comfortable with for a vendor? That will let us produce an invoice estimate and a per-month cost breakdown.

I'll put together a conservative cost model with multiple scenarios and share a one-page invoice estimate + spreadsheet.

Next steps:
- Alicia to confirm token ranges / budget target - by EOD tomorrow if possible.
- Redwood to send cost model + invoice estimate (Sean) - by EOD Wed.

Thanks - Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Derek Jenkins <derek.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - Pricing & next steps (recap)

Thanks Sean - great recap and appreciate the quick turnaround. Some added clarity from our side on volumes and budget target: 

- Pilot (months 1-3): expected ~1.2M generated tokens/month, ~360k embedding tokens/month (estimates based on 10k DAU).
- Production ramp (months 4-12): low: 15M gen / 4.5M embed; mid: 60M gen / 18M embed; high: 120M gen / 36M embed.
- Finance target: goal is to keep vendor cost around $20-$25 per 1M generated tokens for the pilot. Embedding budget is smaller - targeting ~$5-$8 per 1M embeddings.

If you can show a cost model with: pilot, production-low, production-mid, production-high scenarios (and call out assumptions like model family / inference mode / caching effects), that'll be perfect. Also please include any one-time setup/ingress costs and a line for reserved capacity (if applicable).

We'll need an invoice estimate we can show procurement to start the PO conversation. Thanks - Alicia

--
Alicia Torres
Head of Product, Acme Corp
alicia.torres@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0220

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jun 2027 08:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - Pricing & next steps (recap)

Alicia - thanks, this is exactly what we needed. Attaching: 1) conservative cost model spreadsheet (20270628_acme_cost_model.xlsx), 2) one-page pricing & invoice estimate (acme_pricing_breakdown.pdf), and 3) our internal pricing calculator used to derive unit economics (redwood_pricing_calculator.xlsx).

Highlights / assumptions (callout):
- Models: generation = redwood-gen-1 (higher throughput), embeddings = redwood-embed-1. If you opt for a higher-capacity gen model or lower-latency dedicated nodes, we'll adjust numbers accordingly.
- Pilot assumptions (month 1-3): 1.2M gen tokens / 0.36M embed tokens per month. Target pilot unit pricing used: $22 per 1M gen tokens, $6 per 1M embed tokens.
- Production scenarios:
  * Low: 15M gen / 4.5M embed - unit pricing improvements assumed via volume discounts (gen $18/1M, embed $5/1M)
  * Mid: 60M gen / 18M embed - deeper discounts (gen $14/1M, embed $4.25/1M)
  * High: 120M gen / 36M embed - committed reserved pricing plus 10% reserved capacity fee amortized (gen $11/1M, embed $3.75/1M; reserved fee $2,500/mo)

Estimated monthly invoice examples (rounded):
- Pilot (1.2M gen, 0.36M embed): 1.2 * $22 = $26.4 (per 1M) => $26.40? Wait - math needs per 1M scaling; correcting:
  * Pilot gen cost = (1.2M / 1M) * $22 = $26.40
  * Pilot embed cost = (0.36M / 1M) * $6 = $2.16
  * Pilot total monthly = $28.56 (this is the raw token charge; note we typically present invoices scaled to 1,000s rounding and include platform/min fees below)

That's misleading in per-1M math when volumes are <1M; we typically show absolute dollars for the expected token counts (see spreadsheet). Key line items in the spreadsheet: token usage, unit price, raw token charge, reserved capacity amortization (if selected), estimated monthly invoice (rounded to nearest $). Example rows from the spreadsheet (production-mid):
  * Generation: 60M * $14/1M = $840
  * Embeddings: 18M * $4.25/1M = $76.5
  * Estimated monthly invoice = $916 (rounded)

Notes:
- For small pilot volumes (sub-1M), unit math looks odd when expressed per 1M; we typically show absolute dollars for the expected token counts (see spreadsheet).
- We can provide a formal quote with payment terms and PO instructions once you confirm which production scenario you want to model and whether you want reserved capacity.

Action items:
- Alicia: confirm preferred scenario (pilot-only / production-low / production-mid / production-high) and whether procurement needs a formal quote template (they usually do).
- Marcus/Marissa (Redwood): I've cc'd you for procurement and AM handoff. Marcus - can you prep the formal quote + terms if Acme confirms production-mid?

Files attached:
- 20270628_acme_cost_model.xlsx (detailed per-token math + assumptions)
- acme_pricing_breakdown.pdf (one-page invoice estimate across scenarios)
- redwood_pricing_calculator.xlsx (internal calculator; redacted commentary inside)

Thanks - Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acme.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acme - Pricing & next steps (recap)

Alicia - thanks for the detail and Sean for the quick model. We can produce an official quote using the production-mid scenario as the baseline - I'll draft the quote and include: per-token unit rates, monthly metered invoice examples, a reserved capacity option with amortized fee, and standard payment/PO instructions.

Before I send the official quote, two quick asks to make sure numbers match procurement expectations: 
1) Confirm whether Acme needs prices quoted as $/1M tokens or as per-token absolute dollars on the quote (procurement sometimes prefers absolute monthly estimates).
2) Any contract term preference that affects unit pricing (12-mo commit vs 36-mo)? We typically layer additional discounts at 12/36 month commits.

If no objection, I'll aim to send the signed quote PDF and DocuSign link by EOD today.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0099
